summary: [Meta Graph API] objects: Meta Graph API: Page, Post (text up to 63,206 chars, link, photo, video), Comment, Photo, Video, Reaction, Insight (post + page metrics), Conversation/Message (Messenger, separate product config). Global numeric-string ids; field expansion with depth/limit caps (nesting 4 deep or limit(500) silently truncates). Threads is a separate host (graph.threads.net).
